up: Retrieve all compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1156824. For each compound, return the following columns: compound ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum development phase (max_phase), molecule type, and canonical SMILES. If a compound does not have a canonical SMILES, still include it with a null value. Ensure each compound is listed only once, even if it appears multiple times in the document. Sort the results by the compound ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  md.max_phase,
  md.molecule_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1156824'
ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
